response.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) as group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY COALESCE(eventannotm, 'MISSING')), baseline_calc AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) as baseline FROM group_averages WHERE group_avg IS NOT NULL), above_baseline AS (SELECT ga.group_avg, ga.group_avg - bc.baseline as excess FROM group_averages ga CROSS JOIN baseline_calc bc WHERE ga.group_avg > bc.baseline) SELECT AVG(group_avg) as mean_of_above_baseline_averages, AVG(excess) as mean_excess_amount FROM above_baseline
